The impedance function of a parallel $$R$$, $$L$$, $$C$$ circuit has poles located at $$ - 3 \pm j4$$ rad/sec. If the value of $$L = 1H$$, determine the following:

(a) the values of $$R$$ and $$C$$
(b) the quality factor of the circuit
The value of current through the 1F capacitor of figure is.
en.explanation:
Given circuit is shown below,



$${Z_1} = 1 + {2 \over s} = 1 + {2 \over {j\omega }}$$

$${Z_2} = 1 + {2 \over s} = 1 + {2 \over {j\omega }}$$

$${Z_3} = 1\Omega ,\,{Z_4} = 1\Omega $$

Above circuit is a balanced bridge since,

$$\left[ {{{{Z_1}} \over {{Z_3}}} = {{{Z_2}} \over {{Z_4}}}} \right]$$

So, the current through the diagonal element i.e. 1 F capacitor is zero.

en.content: A square waveform as shown in the figure is applied across 1 mH ideal inductor.The current through the inductor is a triangular wave of ................. peak amplitude.
en.explanation:
Current through an inductor is given by,

$${i_L}(t) = {1 \over L}\int\limits_0^t {V(t)} dt$$

So, current through inductor is the integration of the applied voltage across the inductor.

Integration of square wave is a triangular wave.

The square wave can be written as,

$$V(t) = u(t) - 2u(t - 0.5) + 2u(t - 1) + ......$$

Integrating the voltage we get,

$${i_L}(t) = r(t) - 2r(t - 0.5) + 2r(t - 1) - ......$$


Ip = 0.5 Amp.
